b.x: 01 Does the scene still wound? Wire, traffic, fire, assault. Do not become the second casualty.
02 Visible bleeding: clean cloth, pressure. Have someone call emergency services.
03 Unconscious: airway, breathing, recovery position if there is no trauma.
04 Warm them, speak little and clear, give no food or water if consciousness drops.
05 When help arrives: what happened, what time, which meds, which allergy.
